## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file>`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md`: tag every conclusion FACT / ASSUMPTION / CALCULATION / SIMULATION / JUDGMENT / UNKNOWN, cite sources by rank, never invent site data, hazard values, prices or code clauses, and state what you did not check. Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Deliver: performance targets by room type (reverberation, background noise, airborne and impact insulation) from the standard in force, wall and floor build-ups (lightweight timber floors need care with impact sound), plant noise limits at boundaries, treatment strategy for the hall.
Verify: reverberation by Sabine estimate with stated absorption data; insulation from tested build-up data, not guesses; recommend site testing where codes require it.
